thread:
marcus: FYI I opened a docs PR to add an audit-export + legal-hold section with Node/Ruby SDK snippets and an FAQ about retention interplay. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
docs-bot: PR opened by marcus 024h label: docs, compliance
ana: quick read: avoid using 'PII' in public docs for SOC2 context. Let's standardize on 'customer data' and define 'sensitive customer data (SCD)' inline. Also we should not suggest exports change retention policy.
kevin: agree on wording. Also call out that exports are read-only snapshots and do not trigger retention resets or deletions. Maybe a single sentence: "Exports do not modify tenant retention or legal hold status."
riley: legal-hold use case: customers may request an export for e-discovery; we should show explicit metadata fields required: `legal_hold_id`, `signed_authorization_url`, and `requested_by`. Otherwise ops can't validate requests.
tom: SDK question: the Node SDK currently has `fields_to_scrub` and Ruby has `redact_keys`. Do we normalize examples to `redact_keys` in both snippets (docs can say SDK aliasing: `fields_to_scrub` -> `redact_keys`)? Back-end accepts `scrub_list` in the payload. Which name should docs present?
marcus: prefer to surface the server-side canonical name `scrub_list` in the HTTP/JSON examples and show SDK thin wrappers: `client.exports.create({scrub_keys: [...]})` for Node and `client.exports.create(redact_keys: [...])` for Ruby, with a note about param aliasing. That avoids promising SDK parity.
nana: for SOC2-friendly phrasing: add this sentence near the top of the section: "Sensitive customer data (SCD) refers to customer-provided information that may include identifiers or content that the customer treats as confidential." Keep it short.
legal-bot: Suggested legal blurb: "Exports for regulatory or litigation purposes require documented authorization (signed DPA amendment, court order, or written consent from an authorized company representative). Redwood will validate request metadata prior to processing." Use that exact sentence?
nana: tweak to add contact path: append "Submit authorization via support with the signed document attached or provide a legal ticket linking to counsel review."
kevin: ops note: we must include a caution that redaction is asynchronous: "Redaction is performed by a best-effort background pipeline; raw events may remain in encrypted storage until the pipeline completes." Also mention that the export artifact will contain a `redaction_status` field with values: queued/processing/done/failed.
riley: can we include a small example of the export manifest JSON so customers know to inspect `redaction_status` and `legal_hold_id`?
marcus: adding an example manifest and short Node + Ruby snippets.
marcus: ```json
// export manifest example
{
  "export_id": "exp_20241102_01",
  "requested_by": "alice@acme.com",
  "legal_hold_id": "lh_934",
  "redaction_status": "processing",
  "artifact_url": "https://s3.example.com/exports/exp_20241102_01.jsonl",
  "consent": { "type": "signed_dpa", "document_url": "https://acme.com/dpa.pdf" }
}
```
marcus: ```js
// node snippet
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY})
const exp = await client.exports.create({
  scope: 'tenant',
  scrub_list: ['email','username'],
  legal_hold_id: 'lh_934',
  consent: {document_url: 'https://acme.com/dpa.pdf', requested_by: 'alice@acme.com'}
})
console.log(exp.export_id)
```
marcus: ```rb
# ruby snippet
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
exp = client.exports.create(
  scope: 'tenant',
  redact_keys: ['email','username'],
  legal_hold_id: 'lh_934',
  consent: { 'document_url' => 'https://acme.com/dpa.pdf', 'requested_by' => 'alice@acme.com' }
)
puts exp['export_id']
```
tom: added sdk comment suggestion: insert "# Note: Ruby SDK uses `redact_keys`; Node uses `fields_to_scrub` aliasing to `scrub_list`" next to snippets. I can open a small SDK PR to add the alias notes.
kevin: infra heads-up: backend expects `scrub_list` and `consent.document_url`. We already have a ticket INF-6033 to accept `legal_hold_id` in the exports job. ETA 4 business days. Docs should not claim immediate support.
marcus: I'll mark the PR as Draft and add an "Implementation status" callout with links to INF-6033. Also adding a banner: "Preview: server-side legal-hold export features are gated; follow infra tickets for rollout."
nana: also add a short FAQ entry: "Can I shorten retention via export?" Answer: "No. Exports do not alter retention or legal hold state; contact support/legal for retention policy changes."
legal-bot: approve on wording subject to signed-authority requirements being present in the admin console or support intake.
marcus: thanks everyone. I'll update the PR text, push the banner, and request a formal review when backend tickets are linked. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 (Draft, linked: INF-6033)
docs-bot: marcus updated PR #912 024h label: draft, compliance
kevin: :+1: leaving final review until INF-6033 is tracked.
